artifact_digest.covers: canonical JSON of this whole record except artifact_digest.value, so prose (limits and their statuses, fixture classes and origins, notes, CI observations) is bound too

limits.statement: The five adapters emit the legacy sbf.adapter/2 descriptor and sbf.scan-report/2 report. Nothing here is in contracts/next vocabulary: no ContractRef, no sbf.identity-envelope/1 and no T03 capability status exists for them, and every semantic_sha256 is a regression digest, not a contract hash.

The shadow fixtures run in-record test doubles (identity, flipped verb, wrong contract, async). They show how the shell reports parity and drift; no next-IR projector exists, so promotion_allowed stays false and parity with a next IR is not established.

The cutover fixtures pass hand-written booleans. The real state of the ten gates (exact-head CI, independent review, T00 integration) is not computed here, so readiness for T00 integration is unknown.
Sparse-checkout completeness is audited only for ruby-rails and python-fastapi. Any other adapter in a sparse checkout reports sparse-unsupported-adapter and is never treated as complete.

The scanner pins are the static import closure of scanners/index.mjs and scanners/registry.mjs plus every .mjs file in scanners/adapters, which the registry loads by directory listing. A file outside that closure and outside the five fixture trees that changed scan output would not be reported as moved; the live replay would report an output mismatch instead.
Replays and exit codes were observed on one runtime (see environment). The CI observation shows the Node 22.x and 24.x jobs passed the T11 step, but their per-version test counts are not recorded.
ci_observations were read from the GitHub API on the observed_on date; the verifier cannot recompute them offline.
The pinned_corpus_verified gate is outside this pack: only the five in-repo fixture trees are replayed. Behavior on real repositories is unknown here.

identity_interface_frozen and capability_interface_frozen depend on the T01 and T03 interfaces, which T11 does not import. INTERFACE_RFC.md records the intended mapping; nothing is claimed as supported.

verification.unverified_override: BASELINE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED=1 skips only the checks that need the pinned commit, and the test then says so in its diagnostics
not_recomputed: ci_observations: read from the GitHub API on observed_on and not recomputable offline
environment: toolchain versions of the recording machine; only package_lock is recomputed
limits: statements, fixture lists and statuses are prose; the test fixes the id-to-status map and artifact_digest binds the text
fixture classes, counterexample texts, title and notes: prose bound only by artifact_digest
artifact_digest is tamper evidence, not proof: whoever edits a field can re-seal it, so only the recomputed pins, replays and commands prove content
